root_drive_policy.file_name: Book_扫描版PDF教材结构化处理提示词.md

user_decision: Review existing structured data first. Use PDF only when the structured data review cannot confidently resolve an issue; avoid full-book mechanical PDF comparison.

first_time_scanned_pdf_extraction.purpose: Build the initial faithful structured source without skipping pages.

order: Run full structural, formula, logical, numbering, cross-page, source-span, figure/table-reference and provenance checks on structured data.
Classify findings by confidence and risk.
Open only the necessary PDF page(s), plus adjacent pages when needed, for unresolved source ambiguity.
For mathematical correctness, use internal derivation/consistency, counterexamples, symbolic or numerical checks; use external authoritative references only when needed.
Preserve source; store corrections and AI-derived study content in separate layers.

pdf_spot_check_triggers: ambiguous character, sign, subscript, superscript, prime or Greek letter
suspected OCR/transcription omission or summarized passage
figure/table/caption/layout relationship not reconstructible from structured data
need to distinguish a textbook printing issue from an ingestion error

source_authority.rule: When confirming what the printed source says, scanned page visual evidence outranks PDF text layer and model inference.
source_authority.limitation: Printed source form is not by itself proof of mathematical correctness.

completion_metrics.structured_review_complete: All structured records and relationships in scope have passed the defined structured-data review.
completion_metrics.targeted_pdf_issues_resolved: Every PDF-triggered issue is either resolved with page evidence or explicitly left OPEN.
completion_metrics.full_page_visual_verification: True only if an actual full page-by-page visual verification was performed; never inferred from structured review.
completion_metrics.mathematical_review_status: Tracked separately from source fidelity and from full-page visual verification.

data_layers.derived: AI preview/review/practice hints and derivations; clearly non-source and non-official unless separately accepted.

current_project_effect.future_progress_metric: structured findings resolved + targeted PDF issues resolved + mathematical review status; not pages mechanically reopened
